name: bancovde-{year}.xlsx
note: MJSP SINESP VDE yearly workbook (one per year 2015->; {year} is replaced). Links verified on the gov.br page on 2026-11-03.
Landing page with the yearly files and the methodological notes of the state managers.

name: ibge_municipios.json
note: IBGE 'localidades' API (key-less): 7-digit municipality codes, names and UF. Not fetchable from the audit sandbox (robots); documented public API.

name: sidra_6579_municipios_{year}.json
note: IBGE SIDRA table 6579 (estimated resident population), all municipalities, one call per year ({year}); the whole range in one call returns HTTP 400. Years 2022-2023 have no estimate (census) and are skipped.

name: ibge_malha_{uf}.geojson
note: IBGE malhas API v3: municipalities of one UF as GeoJSON ({uf} = 2-digit code). Not fetchable from the sandbox (robots).

name: ibge_malha_ufs.geojson
note: IBGE malhas API v3: the 27 UFs as GeoJSON.
